daily_inference: every_eligible_model; reuse only with matching input/model/policy hashes

training.trigger: new approved data, validation drift, or scheduled refit; each fit produces a candidate, not immediate promotion

deadline_policy: bounded branch budgets; preserve ledger; no active method or research fit may indefinitely block the five-slot draft

computer_defaults.basis: proposed conservative settings for the stated 16 GB machine; not measured performance

cold_start: publish only supported descriptive sections; exact reasons for unavailable sections; all model status rows retained
numeric_data_thresholds: no universal sample-count guarantees; release gates set from grouped temporal learning curves and predeclared task loss
